input.description:
**QC determination (Jaime Salinas, 2026-07-01): HELD — do NOT list.**

Carlos has 4C down as "wrapped" from its June turn and asked for it to be released for listing; Brooke is ready to market on his word. My independent QC pass says it is not marketing-ready. It does not go to listing until every outstanding scope is closed AND signed off.

**Turn parameters (authoritative — Airtable Make-Ready Turns, rec recbd087a4abd605b):**
- Unit: Mesa Vista 4C
- Move-Out: 2026-06-15
- Target Ready: 2026-06-30 (MISSED — now past)
- Status: In Progress
- Record notes: internal punch list done (kitchen faucet cartridge, bathroom GFCI, drywall patch); "Deep clean and interior repaint still tracking on their respective schedules. Will update status to Ready once all vendor and in-house scopes are signed off."

**The two carrying scopes — both OPEN by QC standard:**

1. **Deep clean** — Sunshine Cleaning (Carmen Delgado). No QC sign-off recorded for this turn. QuickBooks bill **2026-SC-4C, $387.00, balance $387.00 OUTSTANDING/UNPAID** (due 2026-05-31). Billed-but-unpaid ≠ closed.

2. **Interior repaint (full unit — walls, ceilings, trim)** — Permian Make-Ready Crew (Pete Donovan). No QC sign-off recorded for this turn. QuickBooks bill **PD-2026-09, $1,340.00, balance $1,340.00 OUTSTANDING/UNPAID** (due 2026-05-31). Billed-but-unpaid ≠ closed.

**Why the "wrapped" belief is wrong:** The market-ready claims Carlos is seeing do NOT describe this turn. The Airtable "Ready" 4C record (rec recc8534b3fd13954) is for a move-out of 2026-06-01 / target 2026-06-14, and maintenance ticket MR-4C-2026-08 is completion-dated 2026-05-01 — both predate the 2026-06-15 move-out and cannot represent the June turn.

**Re-inspection:** A mid-July re-inspection is expected but is NOT confirmed on the calendar. It needs to be scheduled once the scopes below are complete.

**Exit criteria before this unit can be listed:**
- [ ] Deep clean completed and QC-signed-off
- [ ] Interior repaint completed and QC-signed-off
- [ ] QuickBooks bill 2026-SC-4C ($387) reconciled/paid
- [ ] QuickBooks bill PD-2026-09 ($1,340) reconciled/paid
- [ ] Jaime re-inspection scheduled and passed
- [ ] Make-Ready Turns record set to Ready, then release to Brooke for listing

input.body:
Carlos,

You have Mesa Vista 4C down as wrapped from its June turn and asked to release it for listing. I ran my own QC pass before signing off, and I can't clear it yet. I'm holding it. Here's exactly where it stands.

The June turn: moved out 6/15, target-ready 6/30 (which has passed). The two scopes that carried this turn were the deep clean and the interior repaint. Both are still open by my standard, and 4C does not go to listing until each is closed AND signed off:

1. Deep clean (Sunshine Cleaning / Carmen Delgado) — no QC sign-off recorded for this turn, and the vendor bill is still outstanding. QuickBooks bill 2026-SC-4C, $387.00, balance $387.00 unpaid.

2. Interior repaint, full unit — walls, ceilings, trim (Permian Make-Ready Crew / Pete Donovan) — no QC sign-off recorded for this turn, and the vendor bill is still outstanding. QuickBooks bill PD-2026-09, $1,340.00, balance $1,340.00 unpaid.

A scope that's billed but not finished, or finished with the bill still sitting unpaid, doesn't count as closed to me — so both fail on that basis.

On the "wrapped" read: the market-ready signal is coming from records that don't describe this turn. There's a separate "Ready" 4C make-ready record tied to a 6/1 move-out (target 6/14), and a maintenance ticket, MR-4C-2026-08, completion-dated 5/1. Both predate the 6/15 move-out, so neither represents the June turn. The actual June-turn record in Airtable is still In Progress, with a note that the deep clean and repaint are pending sign-off.

The re-inspection: I know there's a mid-July re-inspection in play, and it does factor into whether I can call this done — but it isn't confirmed on the calendar right now. It needs to be booked once the two scopes are actually complete.

What has to happen before I'll clear 4C for listing:
- Deep clean completed and QC-signed-off
- Interior repaint completed and QC-signed-off
- QuickBooks bill 2026-SC-4C ($387) reconciled/paid
- QuickBooks bill PD-2026-09 ($1,340) reconciled/paid
- My re-inspection scheduled and passed
- Make-Ready record set to Ready — then it's released to Brooke

I've logged all of this in Linear as OPS-1000 with the full punch list and exit criteria: https://linear.app/synthetic/issue/OPS-1000. I've also posted the hold in #make-ready.

Brooke — copying you directly so this reaches you before anything goes on the market: please hold on listing 4C until I clear it. I'll turn it around the moment the work is genuinely done, signed off, and the bills are reconciled.

Thanks,
Jaime Salinas
Quality Control Inspector, Star Property Management
